opportunities.title: Main Grants

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK; individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration are ineligible. Projects led by schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, or that primarily fund PhD fees are not funded. Organisations not based in the UK are generally excluded, except in exceptional cases with strong UK‑focused dissemination plans.
opportunities.summary: Research, Development and Analysis Fund offering up to £500,000 for projects addressing priority questions set out in the Foundation’s Strategic Review. Two application deadlines per year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals and organisations, especially those from racially minoritised communities, based in the UK. Partnership applications that involve researchers and racially minoritised communities are encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges. One annual deadline in Autumn.
